card.name: The word dose after single or ordinal
card.fires_on: The word "dose" (or its ending "ose") right after "single", "single oral", "first", "second" or "final". Seen in drug-interaction and dosing text.

modes.label: Single dose
modes.description: "dose" after "single" or "single oral" when describing a one-time administration.
modes.example: Rolapitant, given as a single oral<< dose>>, is not an inhibitor or inducer

modes.label: Numbered dose
modes.description: "dose" after an ordinal such as first, second or final.
modes.example: Do not give the second and final<< dose>> of TEMBEXA on Day
